title: Climate zones of Oceania
intro: Name the Koppen-Geiger climate class of each city in Oceania. The class is read from a 1 km map for the city's location.

questions.prompt: Which Koppen-Geiger climate class does Palikir, Micronesia (Federated States of) have?
choices: Cfb: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer
questions.explain: On the Beck et al. 1980-2016 map, Palikir lies in class Af: Tropical, rainforest.

questions.prompt: Which Koppen-Geiger climate class does Adelaide, Australia have?

questions.explain: On the Beck et al. 1980-2016 map, Adelaide lies in class BSk: Arid, steppe, cold.
